Participating dogs must: have owner willing to comply with all study procedures and available for duration of study; have no concurrent kidney, liver or heart disease or blood clotting problems; have no heart-based tumors.
principalInvestigator: Dara L. Kraitchman, V.M.D., Ph.D., F.A.C.C.
